chunks: 5251 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Durays al-Kunasi, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام:
Regarding a Christian who killed a Muslim, then when he was captured he accepted Islam: 'Should I kill him for him?' He said: 'Yes.'

It was said: 'Then if he does not accept Islam?' He said: 'He is handed over to the heirs of the slain; if they wish, they kill him; if they wish, they pardon him; and if they wish, they enslave him. And if he has any specific property belonging to him, it is handed over to the heirs of the slain—he and his property.'

key_terms.أُولِيَاءِ الْمَقْتُولِ: the legal heirs of the person who was killed
key_terms.اسْتَرَقُّوا: they took him as a slave
key_terms.مَالٌ عَيْنٌ لَهُ: specific tangible property belonging to him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a Christian who kills a Muslim and then accepts Islam after being captured?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about a Christian who kills a Muslim, including the legal effect of his accepting Islam after capture. It also states the options of the heirs of the slain person if he remains upon his religion, including retaliation, pardon, or enslavement, along with transfer of his property.
